metadata.description: xOS Marketplace — Platform for xOS engines. First-party primitives ship here; third-party contributors (60% revenue share) publish engines in any category. Engines are independently versioned repos. Dependency declarations enforce minimum compatible versions. Installed via Claude Code plugin system.
metadata.branding_note: xOS brand term is 'engine' not 'plugin'. The plugin[] field and .claude-plugin/ convention are Claude Code technical infrastructure — not user-facing terminology.

plugins.name: career-intelligence
plugins.description: Career Intelligence Engine — xHumanOS engine for job search, network, pipeline, sessions. v0.73.0: workspace-binding gate primitive — the 3 duplicated hook cwd-guards (the v0.66 single-slot miss behind the 408-stray-commits incident) replaced by one shared manifest-driven gate + CI audit, so hooks never scaffold/commit outside a bound workspace. Carries v0.72 dedup-gate JSON fix + v0.71 claim-grounding gate (resume-engine no longer fabricates metrics) + job-match-scorer off-rubric risk scan.

plugins.name: super-developer
plugins.description: Super Developer Engine - global agentic-SDLC ship-feature pipeline for every repo. v0.2.0 is SELF-CONTAINED: bundles the SDLC rules (sdlc-work-claim, sdlc-worktree-isolation, ship-feature-gate) + fable5-reasoning-validate script and invokes them via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} — no ~/cyborg runtime dependency. User-scope, workspace_binding=global. Canonical source: Exponential-OS/xos monorepo plugins/cross/super-developer (this engines/ copy is a derived vendored mirror, overwritten on each sync).

plugins.name: co-dialectic
plugins.description: Co-Dialectic v4.23.0 - FORAGE: Epistemic Foraging flywheel. New /forage skill codifies the Constitution's Epistemic Foraging principle as a weekly tool-discovery loop: FORAGE (marketplace diff + GitHub trending + claude-automation-recommender + P20 authority-weighted web sweep) -> SCORE against the week's WORKSPACE session-ledger friction (not novelty, never a shared brain's ledger) -> VERIFY in a throwaway worktree (never propose blind; FOUNDATION-FIRST) -> PROPOSE: install is HUMAN-GATED, no auto-install from any marketplace; each verify-passed keeper files its own approval ticket with evidence + one-command rollback, max 3 per run -> CODIFY (pending/keepers/rejects/deferred + memory entry + summary audit ticket). Substrate paths resolved via $CO_DIALECTIC_SESSION_LEDGER_DIR / $CO_DIALECTIC_TOOLS_REGISTRY workspace-adapter vars with graceful OSS fallback (Decision-2 compliant).

plugins.name: brand-intelligence
plugins.description: Brand Intelligence — Persona schema, extraction, and registry. N-voice support for individuals (xHumanOS, N=1) and orgs (xTeamOS, N≥3). Includes persona-onboarding interview, handles, channel directory. Foundational primitive — no dependencies.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Knowledge Graph — Graph data layer for all xOS engines. Phase 1: JSON files. Phase 2: Neo4j substrate replacing all engine file stores. Foundational primitive — no dependencies.

plugins.name: brand-amplification
plugins.description: Brand Amplification Engine (BAE) — outbound brand-building umbrella. Includes the social distribution engine (SDE master orchestrator), flywheel amplification module, hub-and-spoke surface coverage, 9-gate preflight CI for content campaigns, golden-hour scheduling, invisible signal CTAs (bookmark/save/DM-share), platform-native routing across LinkedIn / Substack / Reddit / X / Instagram / Facebook / Threads, and the confidence-ladder browser MCP defaults (browserbase for setup; chrome-devtools-mcp for posting per Irreversible-Action Invariant).

plugins.name: coordination
plugins.description: xOS Coordination engine — brain-multi-session-sync skill. Git-backed session state sync across local Claude, cloud Claude, Cursor, Codex. Session-start hook pulls workspace state and surfaces it as Tier 1.5 context in co-dialectic waky-waky. Install once via setup.sh; workspace declares status format via AGENT_STATUS.yaml convention.

plugins.name: content-adapt
plugins.description: Content Adapt — Transform engine. One idea → platform-native variants (xHumanOS) or audience-specific variants (xTeamOS). Reads Brand Intelligence personas; queries Knowledge Graph for source context.
